modules.text: FDM4 offers ERP, WMS, ECOM (B2B & B2C ecommerce), CRM, DECO (Decoration) and MFG (Manufacturing) solutions.
The fully integrated ERP system has modules including WMS, E-commerce, CRM, Vendor Portal, and Decoration.
DECO is integrated with ERP and streamlines orders for Decorated Apparel and Promotional Products, supporting internal stock, third-party vendors, in-house embellishments or outsourcing.
The apparel suite includes purchasing, manufacturing, sales order processing, financials and an Apparel Matrix grid for ordering in e-commerce.
The WMS is browser-based with touch screen RF scanning, and FDM4 states it ensures 99.99% inventory accuracy; WMS offers robot integration.
Ecommerce includes B2B, B2C and personalized Group Stores for teams, restaurants, hospitality and more.
FDM4 has a native Accounting system including General Ledger, AP/AR and Consolidations integrated with other ERP modules.

customer_segments.text: FDM4 serves both apparel and non-apparel manufacturers and distributors.
The decoration software targets apparel decorators and promotional products distributors.
Customer Water Safety Products is categorized as Decorator, Manufacturer and uses ERP, ECOM, WMS, CRM, DECO.

customer_size_signals.text: FDM4 says its ERP serves businesses of all sizes across a broad range of industries worldwide.
Software supports single operations through multi-company, multi-warehouse, multi-currency needs and is described as fully scalable.

deployment.text: The ERP is completely web-based and runs on almost any browser.
FDM4 provides a turnkey solution including cloud-based infrastructure hosting.
The suite is modular so customers can start with needed pieces and add modules later.

integrations.text: The ERP includes EDI capabilities and supports communication from ASNs to shipping labels.
WMS integrates with robots for warehouse automation.
Manufacturing modules can interface to external systems.

differentiators.text: FDM4 has over 40 years of experience developing business software.
FDM4 emphasizes a native accounting module rather than integrating to an external accounting solution.
The ERP is modular and can be used out of the box with little to no customization.
Manufacturing workflows support multiple bills of materials and workflow design by style.

recent_news.text: Charles River Apparel became a customer in 2019, and Water Safety Products in 2020.

gaps_or_opportunities.text: Named customers include Bella + Canvas (since 2005), Charles River (2019), and Game One (2005), indicating long-tenured customers in the decorated apparel space.
